brick-breaker.html.overview: Brick Breaker is a free online arcade game that runs in the browser with no download or account. Move the glowing paddle to keep the ball alive, bounce it into the brick wall, and clear every brick to win. Power-ups drop as you play, and your best score is saved on this device for instant replay.

faq.q: Can I play Brick Breaker online for free?
faq.a: Yes. Brick Breaker is free to play in the browser with no download, no sign-up, and no payment.

faq.q: How do I control Brick Breaker?
faq.a: Move the paddle with your mouse, your finger on touch, or the left and right arrow keys. Click, tap, or press Space to launch the ball.

faq.q: What is the goal of Brick Breaker?
faq.a: Smash every brick on the board with the bouncing ball. Clear the wall to win, and chase the highest score before you run out of lives.

minesweeper.html.overview: Minesweeper is a free online logic puzzle that runs in the browser with no download or account. Left-click to reveal a tile and read the numbers that tell you how many mines sit nearby, and right-click to flag a suspected mine. Clear every safe tile to win, and your best time is saved on this device.

faq.q: Can I play Minesweeper online for free?
faq.a: Yes. Minesweeper is free to play directly in the browser with no download, no sign-up, and no payment.

faq.q: How do I play Minesweeper?
faq.a: Left-click a tile to reveal it. Each number shows how many mines are in the eight tiles around it. Right-click to flag a tile you think hides a mine.

faq.q: What is the goal of Minesweeper?
faq.a: Reveal every tile that does not contain a mine. Use the numbers to deduce mine locations and flag them before you click one.
